description: This file defines the class DashletGeneric, which extends Dashlet and provides functionality for a customizable dashboard widget (dashlet) in SuiteCRM. It includes methods for configuring display options, building query filters, handling rendering, and loading metadata specific to this dashlet type.

classes.name: DashletGeneric
classes.description: A generic dashboard widget class for SuiteCRM that supports custom configuration, filtering, and display of list data in dashlets.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the DashletGeneric instance with provided options, setting default and custom configurations.

methods.name: processDisplayOptions
methods.description: Prepares the Smarty template and UI elements for configuring the dashlet display options, including columns and filters.

methods.name: displayOptions
methods.description: Renders the configuration options interface for this dashlet.

methods.name: buildWhere
methods.description: Constructs a set of SQL WHERE conditions based on current filters and user preferences.

methods.name: loadCustomMetadata
methods.description: Loads metadata like search fields and columns from custom dashlet definitions if available.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Performs the main data retrieval and processing logic to populate the dashlet display, including filtering, sorting, and rendering.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Generates the final HTML output for the dashlet, including auto-refresh if configured.

methods.name: saveOptions
methods.description: Saves user-specified configuration options from request parameters.

methods.name: addCustomFields
methods.description: Adds custom fields to the dashlet's configuration, based on the bean's field definitions.
